page.layout: One page of text in a single column; page number and running head at the top; catchword at the lower right; no marginal notes; small marks at the lower left are not printed text.

main_text.p: Quod eo magis mihi mirum videtur, quoniam superiori-bus diebus hoc libello nō modó absoluto, sed etiam typo-grapho commisso, mihi for-tè caput eius secundum libri XII legenti locus hic occur-rit, qui nostram tripartitam divisionē planissimè confir-mat. Sic enim scribit: Quid? non quæstio iuris omnis, aut verborum proprietate, aut æqui disputatione, aut voluntatis coniectura continetur? page.notes: Leading quotation marks stand at the start of several lines in the passage from "Quid?" onward; they are rendered only as the opening of the quotation. Small marks at the lower left (a pencil-like scribble) and a mark at the right edge are not printed text and are omitted. The running head is decorated and only partly legible. Long s has been normalised to s; u/v and i/j are normalised as per the rules.
